_note: Metric -> signal-module map, derived empirically from 22 derive_strategy_rule_view probes. Lets report membership be predicted OFFLINE instead of calling the connector.

rules.granularity: MODULE, not column. Any ONE satisfying metric puts the module's ENTIRE signal set in report. RSI14 alone and RSI7 alone unlock the identical 8 signals.
rules.transformIrrelevant: The transform, timeframe rel, window and other column parameters do not affect membership. Only which METRICS appear.
rules.rungAutoProvision: Rung variants (htf_*, ltf_*) come free with the base module. A single RSI14 column at rel:anchor unlocks rsi_*, htf_rsi_* AND ltf_rsi_* with no regime or lower column anywhere in the report.
rules.union: Membership over a multi-column report is the UNION of each metric's module contribution. No probe showed a conjunctive requirement.
rules.defaultAllocation: Every IN_REPORT signal is returned with reportDefaultAllocation = 1; NOT_IN_REPORT returns 0.

unreachableModules._note: No column combination tried put these 7 signals in report - including a custom section carrying MA_ALIGN at all three rungs plus RSI14 and ADX, and a section with benchmarkTicker set. They are presumably gated on strategy-level configuration this stateless tool does not model.

CONFLUENCE.evidence: Probe MTF supplied MA_ALIGN at rel lower/anchor/regime + RSI14 classifyZone at 3 rungs + ADX at regime. ma_*, htf_ma_*, ltf_ma_*, rsi_*, trend_adx_* all went IN_REPORT; all four mtf_* stayed NOT_IN_REPORT.
CONFLUENCE.reading: These are second-order: they fire off OTHER signals firing, not off columns directly. Do not budget allocation for them from column design alone.

COMPARISON.evidence: Probe CMP set benchmarkTicker='BTC' with PPO + ROC12 + CLOSE_CHANGE rank. rel_* went IN_REPORT; all three comparison_* stayed NOT_IN_REPORT. Setting benchmarkTicker alone does not unlock them.
COMPARISON.reading: Likely requires the includeReferencePairs / includeMarketBreadth machinery, which ships with zero columns and contributed nothing in probe PLAT_MTF.

surprises.detail: Despite being the canonical mean-reversion reference, VWAP unlocks no module - not SUPPORT_RESISTANCE. Probe G5 contained VWAP and sr_* stayed out; probe G1 contained SWING_HIGH and sr_* went in.
surprises.consequence: A VWAP-only mean-reversion panel feeds ZERO signals. Add SWING_HIGH, SWING_LOW or PRICE_ZONE to reach the sr_* module.

surprises.finding: TRADES satisfies NOTHING, but BUY_TRADES and SELL_TRADES satisfy CVD
surprises.detail: Probe G5 had TRADES and volume_* stayed out. Probes G8/G9 had BUY_TRADES/SELL_TRADES and cvd_* went in.
surprises.consequence: Total trade count is decorative for signal purposes; the buy/sell split is what feeds the tape-aggression module.

surprises.finding: BUY_VOLUME and SELL_VOLUME feed CVD, not VOLUME
surprises.detail: Probes G6/G7 lit cvd_* and left volume_* out. The VOLUME module needs VOLUME, VOL_SMA20, OBV or RVOL.
surprises.consequence: A buy/sell volume panel gives you tape aggression, not participation. They are different modules.

surprises.detail: Probe G4 contained CLOSE_CHANGE and rel_* stayed out; probe G2 contained ROC12 and rel_* went in.
surprises.consequence: RELATIVE_STRENGTH needs PPO or ROC12 specifically.

surprises.finding: All 9 crowd metrics and all 4 derived metrics satisfy NOTHING
surprises.detail: Probes G4-G10 covered every CROWD_* plus FLOW_ALIGN, SMART_RETAIL, CAPTAIN_CONF, CONFIDENCE. None unlocked a module. FLOW_ALIGN was isolated in probe FA and returned zero.
surprises.consequence: Crowd and derived columns are context for the agent to READ. They feed no scorecard signal. Budget them as narrative, not as evidence.

surprises.finding: Platform sections contribute, but not all of them
surprises.detail: includeRsi alone -> 8 signals. includeMtfConfluence alone -> ZERO, despite carrying MA_ALIGN, RSI14 and ADX columns.
surprises.consequence: Do not assume a platform section feeds the module its columns suggest. Verify with derive_strategy_rule_view.

probes.note: MA_ALIGN at lower/anchor/regime, RSI14 classifyZone at 3 rungs, ADX at regime. CONFLUENCE still absent.
Zero contribution despite carrying MA_ALIGN, RSI14 and ADX columns.

coverage._note: metricsMappedToAModule / metricsSatisfyingNothing cover the full 144-metric corpus as of 2026-09-09, confirmed by probing every legal metric x transform cell (663, zero failures) and not merely one transform per metric. signalsReachable/Unreachable and modulesReachable/Unreachable were NOT recomputed - they describe signals and modules, which the new metrics do not add to.

_defaultParamsNote: Report-default signal params, taken verbatim from derive_strategy_rule_view and cross-checked against two live strategies (EL_ALAMEIN, MATH-C3).
_renames: 2026-09-09: SWING_HIGH/SWING_LOW renamed to DONCHIAN_UPPER/DONCHIAN_LOWER at contract 53.0.0 - identical nativeOutput, timeframeMode and transform set, header stems swingHi->donchianHi / swingLo->donchianLo. The names below were updated; the measurement they record is unchanged because the underlying indicator is the same 20-bar channel.
_extensions: 2026-09-09 (second pass, CAVEAT CLOSED): the single-transform pass carried a caveat - a metric feeding a module only through some OTHER transform would not have been seen. Every legal metric x transform cell was then probed: 663 cells, ZERO failures. Membership is NOT transform-dependent - for every metric, all its non-spread transforms return the same signal set - and the full probe reproduces this map exactly (83 feed a module, 61 feed none, zero disagreements either way). The 108 SPREAD cells are excluded from attribution on purpose: a spread column puts the base AND its operand in the report, so it cannot isolate the base, and subtracting the operand's own signals is not a fix - where base and operand feed the same module it removes the base's contribution too (measured: PPO x spread with operand ROC12 reads empty that way while PPO's four other transforms each return the same four relative-strength signals). Every metric has at least one non-spread cell, so nothing is attributed from a spread cell alone. Raw: data/audit/module_membership_full_2026-09-09.json.
